lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 配给站那边有人托我带来问价。先别收，是请你估。我也写了自己的依据，想听听我们差在哪儿。
lines.en: Someone at the commissary asked me to bring this for an estimate. Don't buy it; they want it valued. I've written down my reasoning too. I want to hear where we differ.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 想跟我比？
lines.en: Want to compare notes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 光记住你报的数，我下回还是拿不准。
lines.en: If I only remember your number, I still won't know next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就看清楚东西，再谈价。
lines.en: Then look at the thing properly before talking price.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我先前光看它擦得干净，就想替它加一截。到底凭什么加，反而没写。
lines.en: I saw how clean it was and wanted to add something for that. I hadn't written down what justified it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 擦得干净是卖相。它本来值多少，和你收拾它花了多少工夫，分开记。
lines.en: Clean is presentation. Record what it's worth separately from the work you put into it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……知道了。我把理由也记下来，不只抄你的数。
lines.en: ...Understood. I'll write down the reasoning, not just copy your number.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天先放着。我把自己的依据写清楚，下回再核。
lines.en: Let's leave it for today. I'll write my reasoning clearly and check it next time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 拿不准，就别急着替整批货定价。
lines.en: If you're unsure, don't rush to price the whole lot.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。这句我听进去了。
lines.en: Mm. That part sank in.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还记得配给站托来估的那把螺丝刀吗？这回我先按东西本身算，擦洗和运送另外写。
lines.en: Remember the screwdriver we valued for the commissary? This time I priced the goods first and recorded cleaning and transport separately.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不先看外面漂不漂亮了？
lines.en: No longer starting with how pretty it looks?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 也看。只是不让它替我开价。你说的，我没忘。
lines.en: I still look. I just don't let that set the price for me. I haven't forgotten what you said.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这回每一项怎么来的，我都写了。拿不准的另外标出来，没先替整批答应价钱。
lines.en: This time I wrote down where every figure came from. I marked what I wasn't sure of, instead of agreeing a price for the entire lot.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就能一项一项谈。
lines.en: Then you can discuss it item by item.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。谈不拢，也知道差在哪儿。
lines.en: Mm. Even if we disagree, I'll know where the difference is.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还记得第一单那户翻修种植间的人家吗？他们又来问了。
lines.en: Remember the people renovating their growing room, our first order? They asked again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 上回那批用得怎么样？
lines.en: How did the last lot work out?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 验收过了，一件没退。这回先问下一批什么时候能看，又特意问是不是还由我经手。
lines.en: It passed inspection. Not one return. This time they asked when they could see the next lot, and specifically whether I'd still be handling it.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你怎么回的？
lines.en: What did you tell them?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先问他们要什么、什么时候要。我又没答应每回都能变出来。
lines.en: I asked what they needed and when. I haven't promised to conjure it up every time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就等清单。
lines.en: Then wait for the list.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。……以前别人来找我，多半是想托我问问母亲。这回，他们先问的是我。
lines.en: Mm. ...People used to approach me mostly to ask my mother something. This time, they asked for me first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这是你挣来的。
lines.en: You earned that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我知道。所以先来告诉你。
lines.en: I know. That's why I wanted to tell you first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门刚拉开，你就看见她站在外面。听见动静，她往前走了一步，手还攥着包带。
lines.en: As the shutter rises, you see her waiting outside. She steps towards the sound, still gripping her bag strap.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么早？
lines.en: This early?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲已经接出来了。我见过她，先把她安顿好，就过来了。
lines.en: My mother is out. I've seen her. I got her settled, then came straight here.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本来想等你开了门再来……还是来早了。
lines.en: I meant to wait until you opened... Still came too early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来。从头说。
lines.en: Come in. Start at the beginning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 门刚拉开，你就看见她站在外面。听见动静，她往前走了一步，手还攥着包带。
lines.en: As the shutter rises, you see her waiting outside. She steps towards the sound, still gripping her bag strap.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 这么早？
lines.en: This early?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲安全转移了。我刚从她那里过来。
lines.en: My mother has been moved to safety. I've just come from seeing her.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本来想等你开了门再来……还是来早了。
lines.en: I meant to wait until you opened... Still came too early.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进来。从头说。
lines.en: Come in. Start at the beginning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 这次来访，她没有带账本，也没有让你看货。
lines.en: This time she brings no accounts, and no goods for you to inspect.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天轮到我来接你。
lines.en: Today it's my turn to pick you up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她换回上层区的正装，站在门口，等你先开口。
lines.en: Dressed for the Upper Level, she stands in the doorway and waits for you to speak.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: ……这身是穿给谁看的？
lines.en: ...Who are you wearing that for?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你先看。看够了再问。
lines.en: Look first. Ask when you've had enough.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算了，再给你一会儿。
lines.en: ...Fine. I'll give you another moment.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今晚什么场合？
lines.en: What's the occasion tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上面有一场晚会。请柬上有一栏，要填同行人的名字。
lines.en: There's a party upstairs. The invitation has a space for a companion's name.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那一栏很难填？
lines.en: A difficult space to fill?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 想填进去的人太多了。有人送花，有人替我留座位，还有人提醒我，带一位“合适的男伴”，对以后的生意有好处。
lines.en: Too many people want their name there. Flowers, reserved seats, and reminders that a 'suitable companion' would be good for business.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 就是上回那张你推掉的桌子？
lines.en: Including that table you turned down last time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那张也在里面。
lines.en: That one too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把请柬放在柜台上，推到你面前。同行人那一栏空着。
lines.en: She lays the invitation on the counter and slides it towards you. The companion's space is blank.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我跟他们提过你。可总有人以为，我只是客气地谢一谢出过钱的老板。
lines.en: I've told them about you. But some still think I'm only being polite to the shopkeeper who put up the money.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 所以今晚要把话说清楚。
lines.en: So tonight you intend to make it clear.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 也想跟你跳一支舞。别只听前半句。
lines.en: I also want a dance with you. Don't only hear the first part.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这身衣服？
lines.en: And these clothes?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 干净的外套就行。我带的是你，又不是衣服。
lines.en: A clean coat will do. I'm bringing you, not your clothes.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好。我在这儿等。
lines.en: Good. I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那一栏呢？
lines.en: And the blank space?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你自己填。
lines.en: Fill it in yourself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你写下名字。她看了一眼，合上请柬，向你伸出手。
lines.en: You write your name. She glances at it, closes the invitation and holds out her hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 走吧。今晚不用你替谁看货。
lines.en: Come on. Tonight no one's asking you to inspect their stock.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……是我来得太突然了。
lines.en: ...I did spring this on you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不是不陪你。是下一场，我要提前把时间空出来。
lines.en: I'm not refusing to come. Next time, I'll clear the time in advance.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你记着，是你说的。
lines.en: Remember, that was your promise.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她收起请柬，走到门口又回头看了你一眼。
lines.en: She puts away the invitation, then glances back from the doorway.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 衣服好不好看，你倒是可以现在说。
lines.en: You can tell me whether you like the dress now, though.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 很好看。
lines.en: Very much.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯。下回再穿给你看。
lines.en: Mm. I'll wear it for you next time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 那一晚，离开当铺后，她一路挽着你的手。到了门厅，有人叫出她的名字迎上来，目光落到你身上时停了一下。
lines.en: That evening, she holds your arm all the way from the shop. In the entrance hall, someone greets her by name, then pauses at the sight of you.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: 这位是——
lines.en: And this is—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我的恋人。
lines.en: My partner.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她没等对方往下猜。
lines.en: She doesn't wait for a guess.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在下层区开当铺。就是我常提起的那一家。
lines.en: He runs a pawnshop in the Lower Levels. The one I keep telling you about.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: 原来如此……里面请。
lines.en: I see... Please, come in.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 有人重新打量你，有人举杯致意。她一一应过，手始终没松。为她留的那个座位空着，她领你在另一侧坐下。
lines.en: Some take another look at you; others raise a glass. She returns each greeting without letting go. She leaves the reserved seat empty and takes you to the other side.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你刚才答得很快。
lines.en: You answered quickly.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 本来就不用想。
lines.en: Nothing to think about.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 过了一会儿，一个你没见过、她却显然认得的人端着酒杯走来。是那家大采购行的管事。
lines.en: A man you've never met, but whom she plainly knows, approaches with a glass. The manager from that large purchasing firm.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: 埃莉诺小姐。……这位就是名单上那家当铺的老板？
lines.en: Miss Eleanor. ...The proprietor of that pawnshop on your list?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 是。名单上一个字都没删的那家。
lines.en: Yes. The one whose name I didn't remove a single letter from.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: 久仰。下一季的货，不知道能不能——
lines.en: A pleasure. About next season's supply, perhaps we could—

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 货的事，找她谈。我那儿只是她那条路的一头。
lines.en: Discuss the goods with her. My shop is only one end of the route she's built.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: ……明白了。改天登门拜访。
lines.en: ...Understood. I'll pay a visit another day.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 他走开时，她低头抿了一口酒，嘴角压不住。
lines.en: As he leaves, she lowers her head for a sip of wine, unable to hide her smile.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还是上回回绝那个采购商的意思。
lines.en: The same answer you gave that buyer last time.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 话没变，听的人换了。
lines.en: Same answer. Different audience.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……今天怎么不问我，为什么不叫主人了？
lines.en: ...Why haven't you asked why I'm not calling you Master tonight?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 私下的称呼。你定的规矩，我记得。
lines.en: A private name. Your rule. I remember.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她靠近一点，声音只够你听见。
lines.en: She leans closer, her voice for you alone.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……回去再叫。
lines.en: ...When we get back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 舞池那边换了一支曲子。她向你伸出手。
lines.en: The music changes by the dance floor. She offers you her hand.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 跳舞你在行。今晚我跟着你。
lines.en: Dancing is your territory. Tonight I'll follow.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 先跟着。等你会了，换你带我。
lines.en: For now. When you learn, you can lead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 第一步有些生疏，她没有笑你。人声渐渐退到音乐后面，她的手搭在你肩上，目光一直留在你这里。
lines.en: Your first step is awkward. She doesn't laugh. The voices recede behind the music, her hand resting on your shoulder, her eyes staying on you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这样就好。
lines.en: This is good.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 散场时，她应下正经生意，又把手放回你的臂弯，和你一起走上回下层区的路。
lines.en: As the party ends, she answers a business enquiry, then slips her hand back through your arm for the walk down together.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那个位置，空着值吗？
lines.en: Was leaving that seat empty worth it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 值。以后再有人问，他们就知道我说的是谁了。
lines.en: Yes. Next time someone asks, they'll know who I mean.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 灯光和音乐慢慢远了。你们回到熟悉的街道。当铺的日子，照常往前。
lines.en: The lights and music fade behind you. You return to familiar streets. Life at the pawnshop carries on.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场，我自己去了。同行人那一栏，我一直空着。
lines.en: I went to that party on my own. Left the companion's space blank.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 有人问？
lines.en: Did anyone ask?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 问了。我说，他店里走不开。……下回你再走不开，我就直接去店里把你拎走。
lines.en: They did. I said he couldn't leave the shop. ...Next time you're stuck there, I'll come and carry you out myself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 报纸写到我们了。“神秘男伴”——我明明告诉他们你是做什么的。
lines.en: We're in the paper. 'Mysterious companion'—I told them exactly what you do.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 他们大概还没来过我的店。
lines.en: They probably haven't visited my shop.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就让他们来。问价的时候，你照常算。
lines.en: Then let them come. Quote your usual prices.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你也照常？
lines.en: You too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 生意照常。别的，等客人走了再说。
lines.en: Business as usual. The rest can wait until the customers leave.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 下一场晚会定日子了。你上次说要空出时间——明晚怎么样？
lines.en: The next party has a date. You said you'd clear the time—how about tomorrow evening?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天的时间留好了？请柬带来了，名字还是你自己填。
lines.en: Kept the time free today? I've brought the invitation. You still have to write your own name.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回那场没赶上。这次是另一场，我把请柬带来了。现在能陪我去了吗？
lines.en: We missed that party. This is another one; I've brought the invitation. Can you come with me this time?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那这场我自己去。你先忙，别又忙得连饭都忘了。
lines.en: Then I'll go on my own. Get your work done, but don't forget to eat.
